mentions.name: birding.live
mentions.description: A birding website that helps people look up bird sightings in their area, with a focus on sightings classed as rare. It aggregates many open data sources (eBird, OSM, Nominatim, etc.), will remain free, and plans to add a mailing list for alerts when birds are spotted in areas of interest.
mentions.audience: Birders looking up bird sightings, especially rare ones, in their local area
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building https://birding.live/ a birding site, that helps people look up bird sightings in their area, specifically those classed as rare. Connects to a whole lot of open data sources (eBird, OSM, Nominatim etc.)

Will remain free, planning to add some kindof mailing list for alerts when birds are spotted in areas of interest.
mentions.author: talking_penguin
